entry.title: Should wallets default to Taproot or SegWit receive addresses while some services still reject bc1p?
entry.summary:
The website [https://whentaproot.org/](https://whentaproot.org/) serves as a resource for tracking Taproot support across various wallets and services. Its current listings remain largely accurate, but there have been recent changes that require attention to maintain its reliability. Notably, Paxful is no longer operational and should be removed from the red area indicating lack of Taproot support, as it is now irrelevant to users monitoring service compatibility.
Binance, previously questioned for Taproot support, has demonstrated functionality by processing withdrawals that include Taproot outputs. Several specific transaction IDs provide concrete evidence of this capability, confirming that Binance’s hot wallet can execute transactions utilizing Taproot addresses. This development signifies progress in Taproot adoption among major exchanges and underscores the need for periodic updates to public resources reflecting real-time service status.
Maintaining up-to-date information on resources like [whentaproot.org](https://whentaproot.org/) is essential for users seeking accurate insights into Taproot integration across platforms. Regular verification and timely removal or updating of obsolete entries ensure the utility and trustworthiness of such community-driven projects.
